rank_math_description: Georgia small claims in 2026: $15,000 magistrate court limit, county fees, the 30-day answer and default rules, no juries, and de novo appeals.
pdf_outline: Checklist: demand letter -> defendant's county -> Statement of Claim -> fee + service -> 30-day answer window -> default (15 days to open) or hearing notice (15-30 days) -> hearing (no jury) -> 30-day de novo appeal -> fi. fa. / garnishment
